description: Mandatory deterministic fixture (CLAUDE.md, docs/07 §3). Canonical state hashes for the fixed seed + DEFAULT_CONFIG + empty command log. Intentional engine behavior changes require an ENGINE_VERSION bump, regenerated hashes (pnpm headless --seed 0xE0A12026 --ticks 10000 --checkpoints 0,1,10,100,1000,10000) and a CHANGELOG entry.
